description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractThingEventStrategy that implements EventStrategy for handling ThingEvent objects in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a template for handling events related to 'Thing' objects, updating their metadata and revisions, and allowing subclasses to extend event handling logic.

classes.name: AbstractThingEventStrategy
classes.description: An abstract implementation of EventStrategy that handles ThingEvent objects, updating Thing instances with new revisions and timestamps, and merging metadata.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a ThingEvent and updates a Thing instance by setting revision, timestamp, and merging metadata.

methods.name: mergeMetadata
methods.description: Merges metadata from the event into the existing Thing's metadata, considering resource path and optional presence.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Method intended to be overridden by subclasses to apply specific event logic to the ThingBuilder. Defaults to returning the input builder unchanged.
